items.title: Read: Retrieving and Displaying Data (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Read: Retrieving and Displaying Data (PDF 60, printed 56), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Read operation database se data lata hai aur zaroorat par mehfooz records dikhata hai. Data parhne ke liye aam taur par SQL SELECT commands istemal hoti hain. Python nataij le kar un par kaam (process) karta hai. Yeh operation mehfooz data ko nahi badalta.
